name: Healdsburg Police Department

property.ownership_summary: City-operated police facility confirmed by the official directory; parcel ownership and legal boundaries are not verified.
property.parcel_candidate_note: Address-only GIS search returned 238 CENTER DR with a CABLE TV use description. Do not assign that APN as verified police property without reconciling the mismatch.

summary: Documentary baseline for the public police service channel. Ordinary street-side sidewalk doctrine is distinct from the unresolved approach/parking area. The service lobby is a federal NPF project inference; California interior analysis and exact boundaries remain open. No field verification or enforcement-history finding is asserted.
recording_summary: Policy 463 recognizes lawful recording of officer activity. That protection, lobby access, third-party privacy, and any actual restriction require separate analysis. Policies 1045.2.1 and 1045.2.3 separately address requested ID-card display and uniform identification; neither is a public filming ban.
field_items: Document posted lobby hours and reconcile the complaint page’s 24/7 form-access statement with the daily 7:30 a.m.–7:00 p.m. lobby schedule.
Record public entrance, accessible complaint/records information, current camera/phone signs, and where controlled doors begin.
Distinguish the street-side sidewalk from the facility approach, driveway, public parking, and secure vehicle areas; obtain maps for disputed boundaries.
open_legal_items: Confirm title/control and exact frontage/right-of-way; the address-only parcel candidate conflicts with official street naming and assessment use.
Obtain current visitor directives, signage authority, policy revision/effective-date history, and complaint-access implementation.
Test any actual recording/removal rule under the qualified California framework; an NPF label is not a camera ban.
Historical enforcement research is incomplete; no facility-wide rights-risk clearance is inferred.
